readings.Aries: The thing standing between you and the outcome is not the obstacle. It's your interpretation of it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Taurus: There's something quietly growing in a direction you haven't examined lately. Look now. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Gemini: Your ability to see multiple sides is being used as an excuse not to pick one. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Cancer: Something is about to feel better. Not because anything changed — because the feeling has run its course. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Leo: You've been waiting for permission to be as remarkable as you already are. This is the permission. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Virgo: Something you noticed and catalogued weeks ago is relevant now. Your records are good. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: You've been seeing both sides so long you've forgotten which one you were on originally. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: The feeling that something is not what it appears to be is correct. Investigate quietly. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Sagittarius: You are searching for a feeling you had once. It is not behind you. It is ahead, in a different form. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Capricorn: The goal is real. The version of you who needs to achieve it at the cost of everything else — reconsider. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Aquarius: The theory is sound. What remains is the part that requires you to be personally involved. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Pisces: You've been available to everyone. Today, be unavailable to everyone except yourself. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.

Aries-Aries.synthesis: Neither of you knows how to be small around the other. Decide if that's exhilarating or just exhausting.

Aries-Taurus.synthesis: Something transformative is possible here — if neither of you insists on doing it alone.

Aries-Gemini.synthesis: Unique compound formed. Properties unpredictable — explore with caution.

Aries-Cancer.synthesis: The attraction was always obvious. The sustainability is the question neither of you has fully answered.

Aries-Leo.synthesis: The warmth is real. So is the risk that you start competing over it rather than sharing it.

Aries-Virgo.synthesis: One of you wants to move before it's ready. One of you wants to wait until it's certain. Neither will be satisfied.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
